text: あなたの　みぎかたに　しろい　てが　おかれてる　なんて　…あたしの　みまちがいよね

structure.jp: あなたの　みぎかたに
しろい　てが　おかれてる　なんて
structure.en: a white hand being placed, of all things

structure.jp: …あたしの　みまちがいよね

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.span: おかれてる　なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a statement holds it up as something surprising or hard to believe. おかれてる なんて = 'a thing like a hand being placed there'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb shape says the thing has been done to the hand by someone unnamed; てる, short for ている, shows it is still that way. おかれてる = 'is placed there'.

patterns.name: 〜よね
patterns.explanation: よね at the end states something and asks the listener to agree. みまちがいよね = 'it's my mistake in seeing, right?'.
